hero.alt: Schematic comparing control and YY1-deficient dystrophic mouse muscle, linking stem-cell CCL5/CCR5 signaling to macrophage recruitment, TGFβ1-associated fibro-adipogenic progenitor persistence, fibrosis and maraviroc blockade.
hero.caption: YY1–CCL5 regulation of the muscle stem-cell niche in a DMD mouse model
hero.summary: In a Duchenne muscular dystrophy mouse model, YY1 loss in muscle stem cells activated CCL5/CCR5 signaling, increasing macrophage recruitment and altering crosstalk with fibro-adipogenic progenitors.
